title: Adverum / Advanta / Advent / Adyen / Adams Resources / Acclaim / Associated Estates — Denominator Quality and Claim Selection V9

notes: AE 2008, AE 2022, AE/ACNJF 2004 and AEC 2004 raw Short -> actual Long.

ADVS and AEC have clean cash takeouts, but long-horizon total returns would additionally include dividends where applicable.
ADYEN NA and ADYYF US represent the same Adyen economic equity but are retained as separate idea units because the thesis date and analytical mechanism differ.

batch_lessons: Negative-EV biotech cash is most valuable as runway to new information, not merely liquidation value.
Distressed investing requires security-class and waterfall analysis; junior recovery errors are nonlinear.
Advanta common shows that a medium-term value rerating can coexist with terminal credit/funding failure.
Advent shows how accounting transition can depress current earnings while improving recurring economics.
Adyen demonstrates that an apparently extreme current multiple can be cheap when the market underestimates growth duration and incremental margins.
AE 2022 demonstrates the opposite: a low multiple can be expensive when the denominator is a fragile normalization forecast.
Acclaim shows that roll-up value should be measured per unit, not by headline asset growth.
Associated Estates shows that absolute entry yield and multiple independent valuation anchors matter more than a relative NAV discount alone.
